_doc: Per-language recommendation for run_pilot.py's --fertility-priors (Step 3, internal-docs/aim1-typology-source-structure-plan.md). Defaults to OFF/no entry; a language gets an entry only once measured against real whole-Bible Clear gold, the same 'measure once, remember it in one line, no code edit' pattern as config/spanext_flags.json / config/gold_langs.json / config/typology/directions.json. run_pilot's own --fertility-priors/--no-fertility-priors and --fertility-lambda always override an entry here for a one-off experiment.

hin._note: measured 2026-09-24, whole Bible vs Clear gold. lambda swept {0.5,1,2} on hin per the plan: all three clear the noise floor (2x baseline-replicate spread; eflomal F1 spread 0.0003, +gloss 0.0002) with exact_span up. lambda=2 gives the largest gain: eflomal F1 .5421->.5487 (Delta+0.0066), exact_span 36714.5->36862 (+147.5); +gloss F1 .5423->.5489 (Delta+0.0066), exact 36746.5->36911 (+164.5). VALIDATED against both plan controls at the same evidence scale (~7125 anchors, lambda=2): a typology-BLIND null prior gives a BIGGER F1 gain (+0.0098) but exact_span DOWN (-285.5) -- pure recall inflation that fails the plan's own exact_span-up bar; an inverted placebo (same weight, wrong anchors) gives only +0.0013 (~1/5 the real prior's gain). Confirms the typology-conditioned PLACEMENT is doing the work, not generic FERF regularization.

eng._note: measured 2026-09-24, whole Bible vs Clear gold, lambda=2 (fixed from hin's own sweep, not independently swept -- see the plan's own sequencing). eflomal F1 .6114->.6150 (Delta+0.0036, noise floor 0.0004), exact_span 53757->54043 (+286); +gloss F1 .61305->.6168 (Delta+0.00375, noise floor 0.0006), exact 54123.5->54438 (+314.5). Clean win, both bars cleared well past the noise floor -- same mechanism as hin (eng has both a free-adposition side for case_marking AND a free-article side for definiteness, so both signal channels apply).

arb._note: measured 2026-09-24, whole Bible vs Clear gold, lambda=2: WASH, inside the noise floor on both scoring conditions (eflomal F1 .87275->.8729, Delta+0.00015 vs floor 0.0010; +gloss F1 .87415->.8744, Delta+0.00025 vs floor 0.0006). Not a loss -- flat, not worth the extra alignment-time complexity. Plausible unconfirmed hypothesis: arb already has GB070/072=1 (real morphological case), so its genitive/dative marking may already be adequately signaled without extra target fertility -- not verified, just a candidate reason not to spend more time here.

fra._note: measured 2026-09-25 (roadmap M1), whole Bible vs Clear gold (NT only, LSG), lambda=2: LOSS, not a wash -- eflomal F1 .87305->.8660 (Delta-0.0071, noise floor only 0.0003), exact_span 42269->41498 (-771); +gloss F1 .8751->.8683 (Delta-0.0068, floor 0.0004), exact -693.5. Consistent with the already-documented fra articles/case_marking regression (span_extension.py, section 5.2b) -- a third, independent mechanism (this time an eflomal-time prior, not a deterministic grab) also hurts fra. Not investigated further here; a real candidate-check/relation-gating weakness specific to fra, not yet root-caused for this mechanism.

spa._note: RE-MEASURED 2026-09-25 after fixing fertility_priors._subject_indexing_incomplete() (see cmn's note below for the bug: an empty Grambank dict was silently read as 'confirmed no subject indexing', inflating finite_verb flagging identically across every Grambank-uncovered language). Flagged anchors dropped 7126->4690 (only the possessor/dative gate now fires via --fertility-typology-fallback; finite_verb correctly suppressed). Whole Bible vs Clear gold, lambda=2: now a WASH, improved from the pre-fix LOSS -- eflomal F1 .8060->.8049 (Delta-0.0011, floor 0.0012, inside the noise floor), exact_span 183296->182660 (-636); +gloss F1 .8067->.8057 (Delta-0.0010, floor 0.0011), exact -591. (Pre-fix, buggy measurement for the record: F1 Delta-0.0026, exact -1187/-1181 -- a clear LOSS.) Still not a win either way. Notably DIFFERENT from span_extension's own typology_fallback verdict for spa (net positive there, config/spanext_flags.json) -- the same typology-derived directions help one mechanism (a deterministic candidate grab) and don't help a different one (a soft eflomal-time prior) for the same language. Do not assume a typology_fallback verdict transfers between mechanisms.

ben._note: RE-MEASURED 2026-09-25 after the same subject_indexing fix as spa (anchors 7126->4690). Whole Bible vs Clear gold (IRVBen -- found and fixed a real config/gold_langs.json bug in the original M1 run: base_text was recorded as bare 'IRV', the parquet's real value is 'IRVBen', so every prior score against this entry silently read 0/0 verses and f1=0.0), lambda=2, --fertility-typology-fallback: now a clearer LOSS than the pre-fix measurement -- eflomal F1 .5994->.5985 (Delta-0.0009, floor 0.0007), exact_span 18427.5->18271 (-156.5); +gloss F1 .5999->.5993 (Delta-0.0007, floor 0.0005), exact -144. (Pre-fix: F1 roughly flat, Delta 0.0000/+0.00045, but exact_span already down -316.5/-282 -- 'not a win' either way, just for a different reason.) Counterintuitively, removing the spurious finite_verb anchors made the aggregate F1 WORSE, not better -- those spurious fills were incidentally near-neutral-to-helpful in aggregate, while the real remaining possessor/dative-only signal is net negative for ben on its own. Still no win under either measurement.

asm._note: RE-MEASURED 2026-09-25 after the same subject_indexing fix (anchors 7126->4690). Whole Bible vs Clear gold (IRVAsm -- same base_text bug as ben, fixed in the original M1 run), lambda=2, --fertility-typology-fallback: now a clear LOSS, well past the noise floor -- eflomal F1 .5572->.5544 (Delta-0.0028, floor 0.0022), exact_span 14676->14396 (-280); +gloss F1 .5573->.5548 (Delta-0.0025, floor 0.0019), exact -259.5. (Pre-fix: F1 inside the noise floor both ways, Delta-0.00015/+0.00005, but exact_span already down -445/-425.5.) Same pattern as ben: the spurious finite_verb anchors were masking a real, larger loss from the possessor/dative-only signal once isolated. Still no win under either measurement.

fin._note: measured 2026-09-25 (roadmap M1), whole Bible vs its own HELFI gold, lambda=2: the intended NEGATIVE CONTROL and it behaved exactly as predicted -- fertility_priors.py flagged 0 anchors (fin has GB074=GB075=1, i.e. BOTH adposition directions attested -> ambiguous -> has_adp=False; GB020-023 all 0 -> has_art=False; GB089=1 -> subject_indexing present -> subj_incomplete=False; every relation gate closed). Result is a pure no-op: F1/exact_span identical to baseline within noise on both conditions (eflomal Delta-0.00065 vs floor 0.0011; +gloss Delta-0.0006 vs floor 0.0008; exact_span moved by -40 and -1.5, i.e. nothing). Confirms the relation-gating logic correctly does nothing when every gate is closed.

cmn._note: measured 2026-09-25 (roadmap M1), whole Bible vs its own SWORD/ChiUns gold, lambda=2: the intended negative control (isolating, no case/articles) did NOT behave as predicted -- it is the LARGEST regression of the six languages measured. cmn genuinely has GB074=1/GB075=0 (a real 'before' adposition direction, e.g. Chinese 的 as a free genitive-type particle is a plausible real phenomenon here) AND GB089=GB090=0 (subj_incomplete=True), so 7126 anchors were flagged -- NOT a bug in isolation, but the finite_verb channel firing for an isolating language with no subject-doubling convention is the more likely culprit. eflomal F1 .6834->.6752 (Delta-0.0082, floor 0.0004), exact_span 100207.5->94932 (-5275.5, the biggest single move measured); +gloss F1 .6849->.6774 (Delta-0.0075), exact -4947. CONTROLS RUN (the required one-language check for this M1 batch): a typology-blind null-prior at the same evidence scale (7125 anchors, lambda=2) is WORSE (F1 .6665, Delta-0.0169, exact -7712.5) and an inverted placebo (wrong anchors, 6638) is BETTER but still negative (F1 .6782, Delta-0.0052, exact -1625). Ranking baseline > invert > real-ferf > null-prior: correct targeting measurably REDUCES the damage relative to blind targeting, but does not reverse it into a win -- for cmn, ANY added fertility pressure appears to be a net cost, not just misplaced evidence. GAP found during this measurement, FIXED same day (2026-09-25, immediately after M1): `fertility_priors._subject_indexing_incomplete()` took no `iso`/typology_fallback parameter and read raw Grambank codes only; for a language with NO Grambank entry at all, `grambank={}` and the function returned True (incomplete) UNCONDITIONALLY -- i.e. 'no data' was silently treated as 'confirmed no subject indexing'. This inflated spa/ben/asm's finite_verb flagging identically to cmn's (all four got within 1 of the same anchor count, 7125-7126, despite different corpora) even though only cmn's True value is an actual measured Grambank fact. Fixed by checking code PRESENCE before checking value (`tests/test_fertility_priors.py`'s new regression tests). cmn's OWN verdict above is UNAFFECTED by the fix -- cmn's GB089=GB090=0 is real, present Grambank data, not an absence, so its anchor count and result are unchanged; the fix only changed spa/ben/asm (see their own re-measured entries).
